name: GitLab
author: Pranav Babu
description: A keyboard-friendly GitLab inbox for notifications, review requests, your own merge requests, assigned issues, pipelines, and projects, for gitlab.com or a self-hosted instance.

barWidget.description: Act on unread notifications and browse review requests, your authored merge requests with their pipeline state, assigned issues, active or failed pipelines, and project metrics.

schema.label: GitLab host
schema.description: Hostname of a self-hosted instance, e.g. gitlab.example.com. Leave blank to use glab's configured default host.

schema.label: Open links
schema.description: Open links in a browser tab, or in a dedicated web app window. The web app window requires a Chromium-based default browser.

schema.label: Project scope
schema.description: List only projects in your personal namespace, or every project you are a member of, including group and subgroup projects. This scope also supplies candidates for pipeline scanning.

schema.label: Include review requests and issues from archived projects
schema.description: An archived project is read-only, so the request cannot be withdrawn and the work cannot be done.

schema.label: Include review requests on drafts
schema.description: Draft merge requests are not ready for review, but some teams do ask for early feedback on them.

schema.label: Maximum displayed projects
schema.description: Caps rendered project rows while search and filtering continue to use the complete fetched list.

schema.label: Pipeline scan
schema.description: Scan no projects, a capped set of recent projects, or every project in the configured scope. All projects can use substantial API capacity with the member scope.

schema.label: Keep the bar icon unlit
schema.description: Keep the bar icon unlit regardless of unread notifications, active pipelines, review requests, or failing merge request pipelines. Counts and rows still populate the panel as usual.
